The apostle holding the knife in Leonardo da Vinci's *The Last Supper* is **Saint Peter**, who cut off the ear of the high priest's servant during Jesus' arrest. 

The Basilica named after Saint Peter is **St. Peter's Basilica**, which is located in **Vatican City**.

Vatican City had an official position titled **"Governor of Vatican City"** from 1929 until it was abolished. The last person to hold this title was **Camillo Serafini**, who died on **March 21, 1952**. His death marked the end of the Governorship, which was subsequently replaced by the President of the Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State.

Therefore, the position of **Governor of Vatican City ended on March 21, 1952**, when Camillo Serafini passed away and the role was formally abolished.
